posts.community: BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange)- Bet on Financialization?
posts.text: There has been some speculation on traders shifting away from NSE, etc. I was wondering the accuracy of these reports, and did a mid month check on BSE volumes over the weekend. Since BSE had 1 expiry more than NSE last weekend, decided to wait till Tue EOD to complete the check. As of Tue night, 13 trading days have completed with 3 expiries on each exchange. PTO market Share: BSE market share seems to have crossed 30% to ~33%. This share will go higher this month, since BSE has 2 expiries upcoming, and NSE just 1. image 1155×365 23 KB Total Options Contract Volumes: BSE has crossed the 50% v…
